label: Tokens, counters and sacrifice: create, +1/+1 and other counters, sacrifice outlets, lifegain payoffs

cards.name: The Earth Crystal
gaps: {4}{G}{G}, {T}: Distribute two +1/+1 counters among one or two target creatures you control.

cards.name: Torment of Hailfire
gaps: Repeat the following process X times.
Each opponent loses 3 life unless that player sacrifices a nonland permanent of their choice or discards a card.

cards.name: Greater Good
gaps: Sacrifice a creature: Draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power, then discard three cards.

cards.name: Zuran Orb
gaps: Sacrifice a land: You gain 2 life.

cards.name: Springheart Nantuko
gaps: Bestow {1}{G}
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you may pay {1}{G} if this permanent is attached to a creature you control.
If you do, create a token that's a copy of that creature.
If you didn't create a token this way, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token.

cards.name: Ayara, First of Locthwain
gaps: Whenever Ayara or another black creature you control enters, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
{T}, Sacrifice another black creature: Draw a card.

cards.name: Monument to Endurance
gaps: Whenever you discard a card
choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn —
• Draw a card.
• Create a Treasure token.
• Each opponent loses 3 life.

cards.name: Sylvan Safekeeper
gaps: Sacrifice a land: Target creature you control gains shroud until end of turn. (It can't be the target of spells or abilities.)

cards.name: Essence Flux
gaps: If it's a Spirit, put a +1/+1 counter on it.

cards.name: Lathliss, Dragon Queen
gaps: Whenever another nontoken Dragon you control enters, create a 5/5 red Dragon creature token with flying.
{1}{R}: Dragons you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Archon of Sun's Grace
gaps: Pegasus creatures you control have lifelink.
Constellation — Whenever an enchantment you control enters, create a 2/2 white Pegasus creature token with flying.

cards.name: Rising of the Day
gaps: Legendary creatures you control get +1/+0.

cards.name: Mechanized Production
gaps: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a token that's a copy of enchanted artifact.
Then if you control eight or more artifacts with the same name as one another, you win the game.

cards.name: Curse of the Swine
gaps: Exile X target creatures.
For each creature exiled this way, its controller creates a 2/2 green Boar creature token.

cards.name: K'rrik, Son of Yawgmoth
gaps: ({B/P} can be paid with either {B} or 2 life.)
For each {B} in a cost, you may pay 2 life rather than pay that mana.
Whenever you cast a black spell, put a +1/+1 counter on K'rrik.

cards.name: Oketra's Monument
gaps: Whenever you cast a creature spell, create a 1/1 white Warrior creature token with vigilance.

cards.name: Marwyn, the Nurturer
gaps: Whenever another Elf you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on Marwyn.
{T}: Add an amount of {G} equal to Marwyn's power.

cards.name: Wishclaw Talisman
gaps: This artifact enters with three wish counters on it.
{1}, {T}, Remove a wish counter from this artifact: Search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
An opponent gains control of this artifact.
Activate only during your turn.

cards.name: Flowering of the White Tree
gaps: Legendary creatures you control get +2/+1 and have ward {1}.
Nonlegendary creatures you control get +1/+1.

cards.name: Charismatic Conqueror
gaps: Whenever an artifact or creature an opponent controls enters untapped, they may tap that permanent.
If they don't, you create a 1/1 white Vampire creature token with lifelink.

cards.name: Descent into Avernus
gaps: At the beginning of your upkeep, put two descent counters on this enchantment.
Then each player creates X Treasure tokens and this enchantment deals X damage to each player, where X is the number of descent counters on this enchantment.

cards.name: Prismari Command
gaps: Choose two —
• Prismari Command deals 2 damage to any target.
• Target player draws two cards, then discards two cards.
• Target player creates a Treasure token.
• Destroy target artifact.

cards.name: Roiling Regrowth
gaps: Sacrifice a land.

cards.name: Bastion Protector
gaps: Commander creatures you control get +2/+2 and have indestructible.

cards.name: Sterling Grove
gaps: Other enchantments you control have shroud. (They can't be the targets of spells or abilities.)
{1}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Search your library for an enchantment card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.

cards.name: Damning Verdict
gaps: Destroy all creatures with no counters on them.

cards.name: Bristly Bill, Spine Sower
gaps: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
{3}{G}{G}: Double the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.

cards.name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
gaps: Creatures your opponents control get -2/-2.

cards.name: Well of Lost Dreams
gaps: Whenever you gain life, you may pay {X}, where X is less than or equal to the amount of life you gained.
If you do, draw X cards.

cards.name: Caged Sun
gaps: Creatures you control of the chosen color get +1/+1.
Whenever a land's ability causes you to add one or more mana of the chosen color, add an additional one mana of that color.

cards.name: Liberator, Urza's Battlethopter
gaps: You may cast colorless spells and artifact spells as though they had flash.
Whenever you cast a spell, if the amount of mana spent to cast that spell is greater than Liberator's power, put a +1/+1 counter on Liberator.

cards.name: Ledger Shredder
gaps: Whenever a player casts their second spell each turn, this creature connives. (Draw a card, then discard a card. If you discarded a nonland card, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.)

cards.name: Scapeshift
gaps: Sacrifice any number of lands.
Search your library for up to that many land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
